0022600018.text: The Knicks (1-3, 12th in the East) visit the 76ers (3-1, 2nd in the Atlantic) for their sixth game of the season, coming off a win while Philadelphia has dropped its last game. New York trails the 2026-27 season series 0-1 after a 106-100 loss in New York on October 20, though the teams split 2-2 in 2025-26 and the Knicks won their 2025-26 playoff series 4-0. New York is missing Jose Alvarado (ankle sprain, out), while Philadelphia is without Ariel Hukporti (Achilles, surgery), Dominick Barlow (back, fracture), Jabari Walker (knee, soreness) and Tacko Fall (quadriceps, strain), all listed as out.
